title: Saawan Ko Aane Do
desc: Rejected by his lover's rich father, poor Birju returns years later as a successful singer to seek the father's approval.

title: Haan Maine Bhi Pyar Kiya
desc: Shiv and Pooja's marriage crumbles after she uncovers his betrayal. As she rebuilds her life, a film star named Raj enters, bringing unexpected change and a chance at love.

title: Bhajarangi 2
desc: A ruthless drug lord, Araka, enslaves villagers to run his narcotics empire. When a determined forest officer uncovers the truth, he sets out on a dangerous mission to end the tyranny.

title: Sikandar
desc: A young, driven rebel takes on a corrupt system, fighting for ordinary citizens' rights and shaking up the entrenched power structures of an unjust nation.

title: Karz
desc: Monty learns the shocking truth of his past life-betrayed and killed by his greedy wife, leaving his family homeless. With his lover's support, he vows to set things right.

title: Article 15
desc: Senior police officer Ayaan Ranjan has to come to grips with the reality of caste discrimination in the rural heartlands of India when a gruesome and unjust rape and murder case lands on his desk.

title: Andaaz
desc: After Kajal marries another man, Raj moves to Cape Town and agrees to wed Jiya, only to be stunned when he discovers she is Kajal's widowed sister-in-law, rekindling old emotions.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Deewangee
desc: Shekhar hides a runaway girl for a reward, but ends up marrying her. Everything falls apart when a friend leaves him stolen diamonds right before being murdered.

title: Kasme Vaade
desc: Raju, guilt-ridden over his brother's death, meets Amit's lookalike, Shankar, and unknowingly becomes entangled in a deeper mystery, making amends while facing unsettling truths.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Simmba
desc: Simmba, a corrupt cop, works for smuggler Durva. But when Durva's brothers assault a woman, Simmba changes sides and seeks justice, risking everything to make things right.

title: Ram Lakhan
desc: Ram, a righteous cop, and Lakhan, his carefree brother, unite for revenge after discovering their father was murdered by two cunning criminals. Justice, drama, and brotherhood drive their journey.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Siya
desc: Siya, a teenage rape survivor, bravely fights for justice against powerful men. Despite fear and danger, she refuses to stay silent and takes on the system.
